text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 279 tablets of lisinopril 10 mg at 12.5 tablets per day (22.3 days on hand). Corvale General holds 317 tablets at 14.1 tablets per day (22.5 days on hand). Both sites have approximately three weeks of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show lisinopril is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Aurobindo Pharma Limited's plant (FEI 3004021229) received an OAI classification on 2010-09-24 and a VAI classification on 2023-07-21. APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (FEI 3011895410) received VAI classifications on 2020-02-28 and 2025-12-17.

Our position: Current inventory is low but stable. No FDA shortage exists. The supply chain reliance on the Aurobindo or APL plants is unverified. Top-ranked alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list, though their manufacturing sites are unidentified on labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (ranked first); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to qualify Almatica Pharma Inc., BluePoint Laboratories, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Chartwell RX, LLC as backup sources; requires P&T committee approval for each formulary addition.
3. Buyer to request manufacturing site disclosure from all alternate suppliers to assess inspection history risk; requires procurement leadership approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily and report changes to P&T committee chair; requires buyer action only.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
